scientific_integrity: The real-rootedness ingredient is a known Pólya–Schur theorem; exact symbolic deductions are separated from finite verification. The Legendre case r=2 and earlier Franel congruences are excluded from novelty claims.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime index and r>=3 only. The full integer discriminant away from p, the global Galois group, and composite index are not classified. Equivalent coverage in unlocated work remains possible; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Prime-index Franel power polynomials: complete factorization and tame discriminant
